$comment: THE LOCALE REGISTER — the one list of the languages this factory ships. Every surface reads it:
tests, the CI regeneration step, the notice-per-locale limb, the content pack, the store tooling and
every native manifest (iOS/macOS CFBundleLocalizations, Android locales_config, MSIX languages).
tooling/ci/assert-locale-register.mjs fails on any hand-typed locale list outside this file, on an
ARB set or a native manifest that disagrees with it, and on a generated file that is not what this
Fields: code (BCP-47 language tag, as the ARB suffix and Flutter Locale use it) · name (English) ·
nativeName (shown in the language picker, in its own script) · script (ISO 15924) · direction
(ltr|rtl) · pluralRules (the CLDR cardinal categories the language uses, an id for the QA harness) ·
status (supported = shipped on every surface; pending = registered, not yet shipped anywhere) ·
apple / android / msix / play (the code each native or store surface spells it with).
`pseudo` rows are TEST-ONLY locales. They never ship and never reach a picker: en-XA is accented and
about 40% longer than English (overflow), ar-XB is the same text laid out right-to-left (RTL).
ADDING A LANGUAGE is a row here (status pending), its ARB files, then status supported; the guard
names every file that still disagrees. Which languages to add is an owner decision, not this file's.
